parse.title: Sepsis (Moon)
parse.text:
Overview

Sepsis (Moon) is a MythicalMythical unit. He can only be obtained by evolving Sepsis.

Evolving

Sepsis (Moon) can be evolved from Sepsis with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Sepsis
x1 Flesh Kama

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • Sepsis's shiny skin is based on when he was a human and he also wields normal pair of Kama.
  • Sepsis has a 100% crit chance against bleeding enemies making his DPS increase by 50% consistently when paired with great bleed units such as Menace (Terror) or Berserker (Rage), both that can output high amounts of bleed ticks for maximum critical hits for Sepsis.
